facts.business: Prashant India Limited was engaged in Textile and Wind Power businesses, both of which have been discontinued with assets being disposed of.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management's plan is to get rid of all debts and make the Company debt free by disposing of existing assets, negotiating with secured creditors for waiver of debt against settlement of dues, and thereafter launch a new project finding new investors.

auditor.name: Ashish Bhoola & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern; Non provision of liabilities

key_risks: Discontinuation of both divisions has affected the Company's revenue and cash flows
Material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as Going Concern
Accumulated losses have far exceeded entire capital and reserves; Net Worth negative since 1998
Current liabilities exceeded current assets by Rs.2753.63 lakhs as on 31 March 2026
Company has not made provisions in respect of certain liabilities and doubtful assets to the extent of Rs.11542.49 lacs
